design_philosophy.core_concept: High-performance control room. Dark, precise, electric.
principles: Data is the Hero: Charts and metrics take precedence over decoration.
Electric Contrast: Use neon accents (Blue/Green/Orange) against Deep Charcoal to guide attention.
Real-time Pulse: The UI should feel alive. Use subtle pulses for live data.
Density with Breath: High density for data, high breathing room for decisions.

usage_rules: Headings (H1-H3): Chivo Black or Bold. Tight tracking (-0.02em). Uppercase for labels.
Data/Numbers: JetBrains Mono. Tabular nums for live counters.

primary.name: Electric Blue
primary.usage: Primary actions, active states, key metrics

rules: Top Rail: Live Global Stats (Score, Active Campaigns). Height: fixed.
Main Stage: Central visualization (Live Game Monitor). Col-span-8.
Remove sidebar navigation during wizard flow.
Step indicator must be prominent and clickable.
Split screen: Left side inputs, Right side 'Live Preview' of the campaign.

buttons.primary: bg-ardito-blue text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-sm hover:bg-blue-600 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,102,255,0.3)]

images.description: Stadium crowd at night, atmospheric, dark.
Soccer match action, green field contrast.

visual_assets.icons: Lucide React (default). Use thin strokes (1.5px) for elegance.

do_not: DO NOT use gradients for text.
DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it technical (rounded-md or rounded-sm).
DO NOT use pure black (#000000). Use #1A1A1A.
DO NOT center text in data tables. Align numbers right, text left.
must_do: MUST use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
MUST implement a 'Live' indicator (pulsing green dot) for real-time screens.
MUST use Skeleton loaders for data fetching states.

setup_steps: 1. Install fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
2. Update tailwind.config.js with the Ardito color palette.
3. Set global CSS variables in index.css to match the Dark Mode palette by default.
4. Install 'framer-motion' for smooth layout transitions (yarn add framer-motion).
5. Create the Layout wrapper with the Sidebar and Topbar.

file_handling.css: Use Tailwind classes primarily. Use App.css only for complex animations.
file_handling.components: Customize Shadcn components in /components/ui to match the 'Cards' and 'Buttons' specs defined above.
